answer: A farm as a result pays the burn once for every alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. The ledge debit happens at intake, terrace totals the burned amount, and grove anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 33 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. A farm of 244 pays that 153 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
